items.title: Nepal PM’s India visit to cover entire spectrum of bilateral ties, says New Delhi
items.blurb: Kathmandu is seeking progress on reconstruction assistance, air connectivity, energy cooperation and longstanding bilateral issues as the two sides discuss arrangements for the prime minister’s visit.

items.title: Living alongside rhinos on the fringes of Chitwan
items.blurb: From Nagarban to nearby settlements, rhinos regularly venture out in search of food, bringing people and wildlife into close contact and raising concerns over safety.

items.title: Traffic resumes on Prithvi Highway after overnight landslide
items.blurb: The Malekhu-Muglin section reopened at 7:45am on Tuesday after debris from a fresh landslide at Ghoptebhir was cleared.

items.title: Kathmandu move to top with fourth straight win, beat Chitwan by 10 runs
items.blurb: Ravi Bopara's half-century did not suffice as the Gorkhas defended a target of 181 to strengthen their chances of reaching the NPL playoffs.

items.title: TIME names Finance Minister Wagle among 100 influential climate leaders of 2026
items.blurb: The magazine has recognised the finance minister's efforts to highlight Nepal's climate vulnerability and push for international compensation following devastating glacial floods

items.title: Rashid’s half-century lifts Kathmandu to 180 against Chitwan
items.blurb: The all-rounder struck 52 off 30 balls to help the Gorkhas recover from an early collapse and post a challenging total in the NPL.

items.title: Landslides block Prithvi Highway, disrupting Tihar travel
items.blurb: Travellers heading home for Tihar celebrations face delays after repeated landslides block the highway in Chitwan, with crews working to reopen both lanes by 1pm.

items.title: How many Nepalis are one flood away from poverty?
items.blurb: Bhotekoshi flood pushed poverty up 2.7 percentage points. Prevention, not just relief, must be the answer.

items.title: Nepal’s game developers seek tax relief, Google access to scale globally
items.blurb: Industry leaders say high taxes and restrictions on Google Play merchant accounts are stifling local developers, as the prime minister pledges to create conditions for a home-grown technology unicorn.
